distinctions.mandatory_price: A selected gain/removal claim must retain the actual response, prior payment or later loss that changes that particular transaction. An independent later closed transaction does not become core solely because the same role or a large material value appears.

distinctions.unknown: Missing actual replies, competing subject choices, unknown tracked outcome and unproved evaluation causes cannot be turned into useful complete answers by shortening.
distinctions.scope: A bounded answer may differ from the primary prewritten question, but it must still answer a useful question; a true root-only description is not automatically adequate. No quality score is upgraded by deleting the originally required question half.
